items.detail: The brief asks for picks at ≥70% probability AND inside −250…+10,000. 70% is −233 and −250 is 71.43%, so both can only hold for probabilities in 70.00–71.43%. High picks on this desk are selected inside that band; every other row is graded Medium/Low. If the intended floor was −250 with no probability floor, say so and the grading rule can be relaxed to p ≥ 55% for the window.

cdn.nba.com returned HTTP 403 for both schedule endpoints and data.nba.com returned a redirect shell, so no NBA fixture could be verified from an official feed. No NBA row, price or prediction is published.

unitedrugby.com returned HTTP 404 on /fixtures-and-results, /standings, /fixtures and /match-centre; premiershiprugby.com renders fixtures client-side. Only the two Top 14 fixtures on top14.lnr.fr could be verified, so Rugby Union has 2 picks, not 5.

items.item: MLB start times are stored as 00:00Z
items.detail: The MLB Stats API returns World Series games with gameDate 2026-10-25T00:00:00Z, which is the US evening of 24 October in UTC terms. Kick-off times for baseball rows should be read as the API value, which is the official field, not as a local first-pitch clock.

No roster/injury endpoint was part of this capture, so predictions make no injury claim. Where an official feed does name a probable pitcher (MLB) it is quoted; otherwise the text says nothing rather than guessing.
